test_title: PYST 9: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:
"Leave someone in the lurch."

options.text: To support someone in a crisis
To abandon someone in trouble or difficulty
To give someone a surprise gift

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. To abandon someone in trouble or difficulty**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Leave someone in the lurch"** means to abandon or desert someone when they are in trouble or need help. (किसी को मुश्किल में छोड़ देना) • **Example: **She left her friend in the lurch when he needed her the most. • This idiom is often used to indicate betrayal or lack of support in difficult situations. (यह मुहावरा कठिन समय में विश्वासघात या समर्थन की कमी को दर्शाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. To abandon someone in trouble or difficulty**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To support someone in a crisis** (किसी संकट में किसी का समर्थन करना) • **Example:** The team supported their captain in the crisis, showing true loyalty. • **Option 3: To give someone a surprise gift** (किसी को आश्चर्यजनक उपहार देना) • **Example:** He gave his wife a surprise gift on their anniversary. • **Option 4: To mislead someone intentionally** (जानबूझकर किसी को गुमराह करना) • **Example:** The advertisement misled customers intentionally with false promises. 3c:T98b, The correct answer is '**the**'.
